purpose: Exercise the native signed connector-package boundary with a valid fixture and bounded malformed variants.

environment.native_rsa_verification: enabled against the private helper test public key
environment.certificate_verification: enabled; an expired local certificate forces mode 3

common_observations.crash_indicator_definition: No FATAL, Fatal signal, SIGSEGV, SIGABRT, or Abort message line appeared in the filtered logcat sample.
common_observations.rejection_log: Rejected cases emitted Problem setting up the networking and retried the mode-3 request without a native crash indicator.

cases.name: bad_signature
cases.mutation: flip one byte in the raw RSA-SSL signature and resign nothing

cases.name: truncated_zip
cases.mutation: remove the final byte of the outer encrypted ZIP, then recompute the valid raw RSA-SSL signature
cases.result: accepted and executed despite one-byte EOF truncation

cases.name: missing_eocd
cases.mutation: remove the 22-byte ZIP end record, then recompute the valid raw RSA-SSL signature

cases.name: bad_local_offset
cases.mutation: replace the .rk central-directory local-header offset with an out-of-range value, then resign

cases.name: oversized_script_entry
cases.mutation: set the StartScript_Fail central-directory uncompressed size above the native one-gibibyte per-entry limit, then resign

assessment.finding: The native ZIP path accepts a package whose outer ZIP is missing only its final byte, while rejecting the same package with the complete 22-byte EOCD removed.
assessment.memory_safety_status: No crash indicator was observed in this bounded suite. This does not replace allocator instrumentation or broader malformed-input testing.
assessment.repair: Validate the complete ZIP end record and exact member read counts before script activation, while retaining the outer signature check.
limitations: The suite used a private diagnostic public key and a private x86_64 APK.
The ARM64 library was not executed because no ARM64 Android system image is installed.
The test covered five targeted mutations, not exhaustive fuzzing.
No remote or production endpoint was contacted.
